'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)]]
**[[Taliban insurgency]], [[2021 Afghanistan attacks]]
***Three security personnel are killed in a [[car bomb]]ing near [[Kabul]]. The [[Taliban]] claims responsibility for the attack. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2021/04/04/Terrorism-Three-Afghan-security-personnel-killed-in-Taliban-car-bombing-near-Kabul (Al Arabiya)]
**[[Afghan peace process]]
***[[President of Afghanistan|President]] [[Ashraf Ghani]] is expected to offer a three-phase peace roadmap, which includes a [[ceasefire]] and agreement, during a proposed meeting in [[Turkey]]. [https://www.khaama.com/president-ghani-offers-roadmap-to-reach-prolonged-peace-report-6546433/ (Khaama Press)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**[[Militant]]s [[ambush]] a convoy carrying [[counter-terrorism]] judge Aftab Afridi, killing him and three members of his family, in [[Swabi]], KP, [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/pakistan-anti-terror-court-judge-family-gunned-down/2198080 (AA)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Cyclone Seroja]]
**At least 80 people are killed in [[Flores]] island, [[Indonesia]], and 21 more in [[Dili]], [[East Timor]], by [[flash flood]]s and [[landslide]]s. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-56635297 (BBC News)]
*Eleven people are killed and 19 others are injured after a truck and a passenger bus collide on the [[G15 Shenyang–Haikou Expressway]] in [[Jiangsu]] [[Provinces of China|province]], [[China]]. [https://www.scmp.com/news/china/politics/article/3128282/11-killed-after-truck-collides-bus-eastern-china (''South China Morning Post'')] [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/2021/04/03/china-truck-bus-crash-leaves-many-dead-injured/7082236002/ (''USA Today'')]
*An [[explosion]] and fire aboard a boat injures at least eight people, some of them critically, on the [[Hawkesbury River]] in [[New South Wales]], [[Australia]]. [https://www.smh.com.au/national/nsw/hawkesbury-river-boat-explosion-20210404-p57gfv.html (''The Sydney Morning Herald'')]
*Twelve people are killed and four remain missing after a fishing boat sank in [[Zhoushan]] sea, [[Zhejiang]], China. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2021-04/04/c_139858160.htm (Xinhua)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Maharashtra]]
*****The [[Maharashtra]] [[Government of Maharashtra|state government]] announces that there will be a nightly curfew as well as a weekend [[COVID-19 lockdown in India|lockdown]] in order to reduce the number of [[COVID-19]] cases. These measures will be implemented from tomorrow at 8:00 p.m. until April 30. [https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/maharashtra-imposes-night-curfew-weekend-lockdown/article34237762.ece (''The Hindu Business Line'')]
****[[India]] reports 93,249 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, which is the highest single-day number of daily cases since September 21. This brings the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 12.48 million. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/with-93-249-new-covid-19-cases-india-records-another-daily-spike-101617507580132.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bangladesh]]
****[[Bangladesh]] reports a record 7,087 new confirmed cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 637,364. [https://thefinancialexpress.com.bd/public/index.php/national/bangladesh-logs-7087-coronavirus-cases-53-deaths-in-24-hours-1617532555 (''The Financial Express'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mongolia]]
****[[Mongolia]] surpasses 10,000 cases of COVID-19 after a record 620 new cases are reported in the past 24 hours. [https://montsame.mn/en/read/259280 (Montsame)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan]]
****[[Taiwan]] receives its first shipment of 199,200 doses of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] distributed through the [[COVAX]] initiative. [https://focustaiwan.tw/society/202104040002 (Focus Taiwan)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]] 
****[[California]] reports the United States' first case of the "double mutant" [[Variants of SARS-CoV-2|variant]] of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] first detected in [[India]]. The variant has been detected in the [[San Francisco Bay Area]]. [https://www.nbcbayarea.com/news/local/double-mutant-covid-19-variant-found-in-the-bay-area/2509887/ (KNTV-TV)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
***[[Greece]] reports 78 deaths in the past 24 hours, which is the highest daily total this year, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 8,380. [https://www.ekathimerini.com/news/1158593/coronavirus-1-955-new-cases-78-deaths/ (Ekathimerini)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Libya]]
***[[Libya]] receives its first shipment of more than 100,000 doses of the [[Russia]]n [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/4/4/first-drop-of-rain-libya-receives-covid-vaccine-delivery (Al Jazeera)]
